solubility_sources.evidence: Table II smooths the authors' data together with Mason–Dodge data. The three 1000 psia entries are beyond the authors' reported 827 psia experimental maximum. The deposited Table I with the individual measurements was unavailable.
Tables III–V contain measurements at 10, 20 and 30 wt %. The two 25 wt %, 107 °C Table VI values in the 'this study' column are interpolations from Figures 3 and 4.

Sixteen candidate measured rows in the 2 M blocks at 313 and 323 K. The 313 K entry printed as 104.0.727 cannot be screened or scored numerically. The authors report concentration variations generally below 3 %, occasionally up to 5 % at low pressure, and about 2 % error in solution analysis.
The abstract confirms measurements with DEA. The Zotero item has no PDF, and HAL's ISTEX full-text link did not serve the PDF. Table and overlap remain unverified.

model_comparisons.deviation: 20.6 % pooled average relative deviation of CO₂ partial pressure. Table 1 lists 159 fitted ternary CO₂ points, including 101 Lee, 8 Lal, 20 Bhairi, and 30 Lawson–Garst. Matching individual literature rows to the DEA calibration was not verified.
model_comparisons.lawson_garst_comparison: §4.2.2 p. 3478 assigns mean relative deviations of 14.4 % to CO₂ and 20.6 % to H₂S, in that order in the text, for ternary Lawson–Garst data excluded from their fit. Figure 6 is the CO₂ comparison at 25 wt % DEA and 310–366 K. Figure 5 is the H₂S comparison.
model_comparisons.limit: The 35 % Lal deviation on p. 3478 is for the mixed-gas system.
